items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: I'd never seen a man to play with a banjo like he did... But I'd had to show him the music.

ctx.x: Pinn's. Yeah, that fella, I'd never seen a man to play with a banjo like he did. He could run all up and down that fingerboard and play anything, any kind of chords, make his own chords. But I'd had to show him the music. Oh, that'd you know. But that fella could execute.
